title: Wat Arun
blurb: The Temple of Dawn on the Chao Phraya: an 80 m Khmer-style central prang skinned in Chinese porcelain mosaics, ringed by four satellite prangs, terraces, and riverside pavilions.

sourceUrls.label: Tourism Authority of Thailand: Wat Arun

systems.name: Central prang
systems.description: The Khmer-style central tower: stepped base, six receding tiers, niches, lotus-bud crown and the seven-pronged Trident of Shiva.

systems.name: Satellite prangs
systems.description: The four smaller prangs at the corners of the central tower.

systems.name: Terraces and stairs
systems.description: The two terraces with their steep stairs and balustrades.

systems.name: Statues and figures
systems.description: Indra on Erawan, Chinese stone figures, demon guardians and the Niramitr Buddha.

systems.name: Porcelain mosaics
systems.description: Bands and floral panels standing in for the Chinese porcelain mosaic skin.

systems.name: Ordination Hall
systems.description: The bot with the Niramitr Buddha: platform, walls, roof tiers, spire and ceramic trim.

systems.name: Riverside pavilions
systems.description: The six Chinese-style green-granite pavilions at the riverside.
